verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm n8n can be extended with new integrations and has custom node development documentation, though one user calls that documentation weak. The pack contains no first-party docs for a node SDK, connector CLI, or developer platform. The CLI evidence covers hosting/operations and the Code node is in-workflow scripting, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: first-party custom-node/connector SDK documentation, a node-scaffolding CLI or tooling, evidence of private (non-published) integration packaging and installation, and stronger hands-on corroboration of documentation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: Easily extendable and new integrations can be built easily.
